## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are scoped to one SDK/plugin/doc where possible

- [ ] If the wire format changed, `API.md` and `openapi.yaml` are updated too
- [ ] Added an entry to [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) under "Unreleased"
- [ ] For forum plugin changes, tested against at least one real forum (noted above)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (JS SDK / MCP server) or the package imports cleanly (Python SDK)
